'pipse' is a typo for 'pipes'; translated as 'المواسير'.
'safety healthy' is garbled (probably 'safety helmet'); translated as 'خوذة السلامة'.
'healthy equipments' is garbled; translated as 'مهمات السلامة والصحة'.
'Rupper ball' is a typo for 'Rubber ball'; translated as 'كرة مطاطية'.
'Inspect tube leakage by pressurized the shell and blocked any tube leaks' is garbled; translated by intent as 'فحص تسرب المواسير بضغط الغلاف وسد أي مواسير مسربة'.
The safety table header row has 3 columns while the valve rows have 5; mirrored exactly as in the source.
